notes: Damage facts are computed by the ported AI damage calculator (aicalc/calc/); this file needs no damage section. The screenshot's panel remains the provenance: Selfdestruct 143.3-169.8% (KOs on every roll), Brick Break 26.4-32%, Accelerock 11.3-13.2%.
Selfdestruct: 143.3-169.8% -> KOs on every roll (so certainly on the AI's max-roll check). Brick Break 26.4-32%, Accelerock 11.3-13.2%, Stealth Rock 0%.

best_damaging_move is over the AI's *comparable* damage table, not raw damage: TrainerAI_CalcAllDamage zeroes out any move whose effect is in sNoDamageCalcMoveEffects -- Selfdestruct's HALVE_DEFENSE effect is the first entry -- so the comparison sees {Brick Break 17, Accelerock 7} and Brick Break wins. Selfdestruct's own block never consults the comparison. See DECOMP_NOTES.md.
Assumed: it is turn 1 of the whole battle; both trainers have living party members besides the active Pokemon.

Expected picks hand-verified: Stealth Rock rides Expert's 50% +1 coin flip; Selfdestruct is dragged down by Evaluate Attacks' suicide deprioritise and Expert's high-HP-while-slower penalty, with only Risky's 50% +2 pulling it back; Accelerock is out-damaged (-1) and dominated.
